A short scene can contrast the character’s belief that each action is isolated with the defender’s view of the whole timeline. Include a scene where a support worker patiently restores the victim’s control, giving the account a human resolution rather than treating the victim as mere plot machinery. That gives readers procedural realism, emotional stakes, and a clear understanding of how identity theft is detected, while leaving out instructions that could be used against a real person.
